articles.title: Violette Dorange forced to withdraw
articles.excerpt: Following the collision on November 1st off the coast of Bréhat, Violette Dorange and her team did everything possible to get Initiatives-Cœur underway again. Extensive investigations carried out in Lorient revealed more significant structural damage than that observed during the stopover in Roscoff. The time required for repairs will prevent Violette from resuming the race.

articles.title: Bowsprit broken off on 11th Hour racing
articles.excerpt: After making a strong start to the first five days of her first Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe race of Italian-American skipper Francesca Clapcich (11th Hour Racing) looks set to be compromised by the loss last night of the bowsprit of her IMOCA.

articles.title: no respite on the atlantic battleground
articles.excerpt: Il y a ceux qui voudraient plus de vent, ceux qui en ont largement assez et ceux qui aimeraient simplement que la mer leur fiche la paix. Cinq jours après le départ de Saint-Malo, l'Atlantique propose un menu dont personne n'a choisi les plats. Dépression tropicale près des Antilles, grosse marmite météorologique autour des Açores, alizés qui brillent par leur absence : les six catégories de la Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe évoluent dans des mondes bien différents.

articles.title: Boris Herrmann: “Catching up with Corentin? Never say never”
articles.excerpt: In the IMOCA class, Corentin Horeau (MACSF) still leads the pack. Behind him, Boris Herrmann (Malizia 4) made a significant leap, climbing back into second place. It was a tough battle with Francesca Clapcich (11th Hour Racing) and Sam Goodchild (MACIF Santé Prévoyance), as well as against the elements. He gave his report today. articles.title: INJURED AMBROGIO BECCARIA DIVERTS TO THE AZORES
articles.excerpt: On Thursday, November 5th at 10:07 PM UTC, while sailing in rough seas and in 5th place in the Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe, Ambrogio Beccaria, skipper of the IMOCA Allagrande Mapei, fell heavily in his cockpit.

articles.title: Vincent Riou announces his withdrawal
articles.excerpt: After a breakdown on his Class40 Pierreval - Fondation GoodPlanet, Vincent had gone to La Coruña, Spain, to carry out the necessary repairs.

articles.title: joy division
articles.excerpt: Ce sont des « matchs dans le match » qui sont passionnants à suivre. En Vintage Multi, Damien Seguin (Arkéa – Handicap International) et Éric Péron (French Touch – Oceania Hotels) se livrent un duel de chaque instant. Chez les Vintage Mono, ils sont quatre à « se tenir » en moins d’une trentaine de milles. Certains d’entre eux se sont confiés ce matin pendant la vacation, évoquant leur plaisir d’être en mer et de tout donner.

articles.title: Catch ‘Coco’ if you can!
articles.excerpt: Since making his escape two days ago, when he outsmarted the two class leaders, Italy’s Ambrogio Beccaria (Allagrande Mapei) and Franco-Brit Sam Goodchild (MACIF Santé Prévoyance), French skipper Corentin Horeau (MACSF) has built what looks like a secure lead at the front of the 21 boat IMOCA fleet on the Route du Rhum Destination Gaudeloupe, solo ocean sprint across the Atlantic.

articles.title: Shoulder dislocation for Erwan Le Draoulec
articles.excerpt: Erwan Le Draoulec s'est luxé l'épaule lors d'une manœuvre ce matin dans 25 nœuds de vent. S'il a réussi à la remettre en place seul, son équipe à terre évalue actuellement les options pour la suite de sa course.

articles.title: 🌦️ WEATHER CONSULT BULLETIN OF NOVEMBER 5
articles.excerpt: Ce jeudi 5 novembre, 4 jours après le départ de la Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe 2026, tous les yeux sont rivés sur la dépression qui se creuse rapidement dans les parages des Açores.

articles.title: tales of the unexpected
articles.excerpt: Two low chaotic pressure systems are affecting the fleets. The IMOCA and Ocean Fifty classes are already dealing with the effects of a weather system near the Azores, which is expected to hit the Class40 fleet even harder on Friday. Further ahead, the Ultim trimarans must deal with another disturbance—a tropical storm—as they approach the French Caribbean Islands

articles.title: Tough times
articles.excerpt: The Route du Rhum Destination Guadeloupe fleet continues its progress in robust conditions, still reeling from the capsizing of one of the favorites, Armel Le Cléac’h (Maxi Banque Populaire XI, Ultim). This afternoon he was picked up by a Panamanian tanker. He is in good health. The Bank Populaire team have acknowledged of everyone who contributed to his rescue and to those who have been mobilised to recover the boat. Le Cléac’h has a complicated history with this solo ocean sprint.

articles.title: 📸 Selfies of our sailors
articles.excerpt:
Toutes les classes poursuivent leur route à travers l’Atlantique ! Certains skippers naviguent au large des Açores, d’autres approchent de la pointe de l’Espagne… Tous avancent à leur rythme, mais avec un seul et même objectif : rejoindre la Guadeloupe ! 

Entre deux manœuvres, ils prennent le temps d’immortaliser leur aventure. Découvrez leurs derniers clichés envoyés depuis le bord ! 📸⛵

articles.excerpt: This Wednesday, November 4th, three days after the start of the Route du Rhum – Destination Guadeloupe 2026, the weather situation is very complex in the Atlantic, with anticyclonic ridges and low-pressure areas. A low-pressure system will rapidly deepen in the coming hours near the Azores.
